For true 4K front AND 4K rear recording, my top recommendation in November 2026 is the VIOFO A229 Ultra 2CH.

The important distinction is that many premium dash cams advertise "4K dual camera" but actually record 4K in front and only 1080p or 2K in the rear. I've narrowed the choices to models that offer 4K on both cameras.

The VIOFO A229 Ultra is particularly compelling because it uses the same 8MP Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 sensor at both ends, rather than compromising on the rear camera. 
VIOFO
+1

What I would prioritize

Nighttime license plate readability: Sensor quality, HDR processing and motion blur matter as much as resolution.

Parking surveillance: Look for buffered parking recording, which can preserve footage from before an impact. Usually requires a separate hardwire kit.

Heat resistance: A supercapacitor-based dash cam is preferable for hot parked cars.

Storage: Two simultaneous 4K video streams consume significant space. I'd start with a 256GB or 512GB high-endurance microSD card, subject to the camera's supported capacity.

One caveat: the popular VIOFO A329S is an excellent dash cam, but it records 4K front + 2K rear, so it doesn't meet your exact requirement. 
Car and Driver
+1

My recommendation: Buy the VIOFO A229 Ultra 2CH if your priority is sharp footage from both directions.

One question that could change my recommendation: Is your main priority the best nighttime video quality, or the best 24/7 parking surveillance? Those two priorities can favor different dash cams.
